// diagnostic

E0209

A named binding passed where it would be silently cloned — Move-param arg without the move marker `^`, or a std constructor consuming a borrowed value (D-MEM1/S2; hard error, was lint `L0201`)

What

A named binding passed where it would be silently cloned — Move-param arg without the move marker `^`, or a std constructor consuming a borrowed value (D-MEM1/S2; hard error, was lint `L0201`)

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0209

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0209: tests/ui/core_consuming_borrowed_field.stderr.

    |
  5 | struct Email {
    |        ^^^^^
 Why: check the method name on this type
 Fix: define it inside `struct Address` or `impl Address`

Error [E0209]: implicit clone of `e.addr`
  --> tests/ui/core_consuming_borrowed_field.jet:11:48
    |
 11 | fn shallow(e: Email) DataTree -> DataTree.Text(e.addr)
    |                                                ^^^^^^
 Why: `Text` stores its own copy of this value
 Fix: write `~e.addr` to copy explicitly
